verdict.rationale: Persona Accounts group all of a person's data and history in one place, and reusing the same reference ID links multiple inquiries to one account, so a returning user can be recognized across sessions. Connect lets Persona organizations share KYC/KYB data through Share Tokens, which supports reuse across products. The evidence does not document a re-verification flow that relies on a prior passed check instead of a full re-run. missing for 10: documented re-verification flow (e.g. a lightweight selfie re-check against stored data), explicit guidance on skipping or short-circuiting re-checks for already-verified users, depth on how Connect share tokens carry verification status, independent or hands-on corroboration.
